text: …　…　ゴクゴク…　…　ゴクゴク…　…　ヤマブキ　シティに　いく　なら…　…　…　…　とおって　いいよ　おちゃを　むこうの　ゲートの　けいびいんにも　わけてあげよう…

structure.jp: …　…　ゴクゴク…　…　ゴクゴク…　…
ヤマブキ　シティに　いく　なら…　…　…　…
structure.en: if you're going to Saffron City...

structure.jp: むこうの　ゲートの　けいびいんにも
structure.en: with the guards at the other gates too

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a verb means 'if that is the case'. いく　なら = 'if you're going'.

patterns.name: 〜ていい
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb followed by いい gives permission: 'it's fine to do it'. とおって　いい = 'you may go through'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb means doing it as a favour for someone; the よう ending adds 'I think I'll'. わけてあげよう = 'I'll share it with them'.
